criterion_text: Direct P2P and Relay share identity and recovery semantics across disconnect, dropped Progress/notice, renderer replacement, route swap, two subscribers (one slow) and near-credit-exhaustion; recovery remains possible when a pre-close notice cannot be delivered, with bounded retries and no global producer stall.

verifiers.summary: Direct P2P and Relay share identity and recovery semantics; slow/stale/retired subscriptions are isolated and transport loss still recovers

evidence.value: exact SHA c1491cf11fb3daab2bf87673e1ac89ad84ab7dfe: P2P and Relay carried the same Agent-minted subscription identity; a route swap retired the old generation so its notice could not start recovery, while the fresh binding did; two subscribers kept independent credit (one stalled did not consume the other), capacity pressure failed only the affected subscriber, a lost transport re-began the relay and requested history, and the Relay forwarded the wire unchanged without stalling the producer
